title: Question 21
passage:
The status light is too bright for the video we’re recording.
A. The battery is already fully charged. B. I'll turn the light down and leave the device on. C. I’ll move the camera a little closer to it.
passageZh:
我們正在錄影，狀態指示燈太亮了。
A. 電池已經充飽了。
B. 我會調暗燈光，讓裝置維持開啟。
C. 我把相機移得離它近一點。
